src: remaining tile s in each horizontal band
dst: ordered same-pattern tile pair d0->d1 in the same band
match_cond: d0 and d1 have identical equality pattern, and s.colors are all present in d0
transform: recolor s by the d0.color -> d1.color mapping
grid_shape: same height as input, one tile-column wide
symbol_instructions: within each band, the matched tile pair is an example that defines the color substitution for the third tile
